memories.author: D05
memories.text: Rheumatoid arthritis and vitamin D deficiency. Patient reports morning stiffness in hands and knees lasting ~45 minutes, mild fatigue. Examination: tender swollen MCP and PIP joints bilaterally, no deformities. Spirometry not indicated. Asthma Control Test not applicable. Smoking: never. Plan: start methotrexate 10 mg weekly, folic acid 5 mg weekly, hydroxychloroquine 200 mg OD, prednisolone 5 mg OD, cholecalciferol 60000 IU weekly for 8 weeks then 1000 IU OD. Review in 3 months.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum 25-hydroxyvitamin D: 14 ng/mL (ref 30-100). Serum calcium: 9.2 mg/dL (8.5-10.5). Serum phosphate: 3.4 mg/dL (2.5-4.5). ESR: 28 mm/hr (0-20). CRP: 6 mg/L (<5). Rheumatoid factor: 45 IU/mL (<14). Anti-CCP: 68 U/ml (<20). LFT: ALT 22 U/L, AST 20 U/L, ALP 80 U/L, bilirubin 0.9 mg/dL – all normal.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Methotrexate 10 mg oral once weekly
Folic acid 5 mg oral once weekly
Hydroxychloroquine 200 mg oral daily
Prednisolone 5 mg oral daily
Cholecalciferol 60000 IU oral once weekly for 8 weeks, then 1000 IU oral daily

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Feeling better, less morning stiffness now about 20 minutes. No new joint swelling. Taking all medicines as prescribed. No side effects noticed.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Rheumatoid arthritis, improving. Morning stiffness 15-20 minutes, mild fatigue. Exam: mild tenderness in wrists, no synovitis. Spirometry: FEV1 2.85 L (92% pred), FVC 3.40 L (88% pred), FEV1/FVC 0.84; change from baseline +0.10 L. Asthma Control Test not needed. Smoking: never. Technique checked: correct for inhalers (none). Plan: continue current meds, consider tapering prednisolone if labs allow. Review in 2 months.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum 25-hydroxyvitamin D: 32 ng/mL (ref 30-100). Serum calcium: 9.4 mg/dL. Serum phosphate: 3.6 mg/dL. ESR: 18 mm/hr. CRP: 3 mg/L. Rheumatoid factor: 30 IU/mL. Anti-CCP: 42 U/ml. LFT: ALT 24, AST 21, ALP 78, bilirubin 0.8 – normal.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Methotrexate increased to 15 mg oral once weekly
Folic acid 5 mg oral once weekly
Hydroxychloroquine 200 mg oral daily
Prednisolone reduced to 2.5 mg oral daily
Cholecalciferol 1000 IU oral daily (maintenance)

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment booked for review with Dr Suresh Menon on 2025-09-15 at 10:30 AM.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Rheumatoid arthritis, stable. Morning stiffness ~10 minutes, no fatigue. Exam: no joint swelling, mild tenderness in left knee. Spirometry: FEV1 2.90 L (94% pred), FVC 3.45 L (90% pred), FEV1/FVC 0.84; change +0.05 L since last. Asthma Control Test not applicable. Smoking: never. Inhaler technique: N/A. Plan: maintain methotrexate 15 mg weekly, folic acid, hydroxychloroquine, prednisolone 2.5 mg daily, vitamin D 1000 IU daily. Review in 3 months.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum 25-hydroxyvitamin D: 35 ng/mL (ref 30-100). Serum calcium: 9.5 mg/dL. Serum phosphate: 3.7 mg/dL. ESR: 12 mm/hr. CRP: 2 mg/L. Rheumatoid factor: 22 IU/mL. Anti-CCP: 30 U/ml. LFT: ALT 23, AST 20, ALP 76, bilirubin 0.7 – normal.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Vitamin D3 cholecalciferol 1000 IU oral daily continued
Methotrexate 15 mg oral once weekly
Folic acid 5 mg oral once weekly
Hydroxychloroquine 200 mg oral daily
Prednisolone 2.5 mg oral daily

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Increased pain and swelling in right knee over past 3 weeks, morning stiffness now about 30 minutes. Feeling more tired. Medicines taken as prescribed.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Rheumatoid arthritis flare. Right knee swollen, warm, tender; morning stiffness 30 minutes, fatigue moderate. Exam: right knee effusion, mild tenderness in left wrist. Spirometry: FEV1 2.80 L (91% pred), FVC 3.38 L (88% pred), FEV1/FVC 0.83; change -0.10 L since last. Asthma Control Test not needed. Smoking: never. Technique checked: N/A. Plan: add short course prednisolone 10 mg daily for 5 days then taper to 5 mg daily; continue methotrexate 15 mg weekly, folic acid, hydroxychloroquine, vitamin D. Review in 4 weeks.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Prednisolone 10 mg oral daily for 5 days, then taper to 5 mg oral daily
Methotrexate 15 mg oral once weekly
Folic acid 5 mg oral once weekly
Hydroxychloroquine 200 mg oral daily
Cholecalciferol 1000 IU oral daily

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Chest X-ray performed to rule out interstitial lung disease due to methotrexate. Findings: lungs clear, no infiltrates, no pleural effusion. Cardiac silhouette normal. No evidence of fibrosis.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Rheumatoid arthritis, well controlled. Morning stiffness <5 minutes, no fatigue. Exam: no joint swelling or tenderness. Spirometry: FEV1 2.95 L (96% pred), FVC 3.50 L (91% pred), FEV1/FVC 0.84; change +0.15 L since last flare. Asthma Control Test not applicable. Smoking: never. Inhaler technique: N/A. Plan: taper prednisolone to 2.5 mg daily, aim to discontinue if stable; continue methotrexate 15 mg weekly, folic acid, hydroxychloroquine, vitamin D 1000 IU daily. Review in 3 months.
